label: Verrocchio's workshop, Florence
summary: Workshop of Andrea del Verrocchio (pe-verrocchio) in Florence, where Leonardo trained.

claims.value: Verrocchio family house, corner of Via dell'Agnolo and Via de' Macci, parish of Sant'Ambrogio
claims.statement: The Verrocchio family owned a house at the corner of Via dell'Agnolo and Via de' Macci (formerly Via Pentolini) from at least 1451, in the parish of Sant'Ambrogio; the early workshop is thought to have been there.

sources.cite: La Toscana di Leonardo, Verrocchio's shop (regional itinerary page, background only).

check_in: Butterfield, The Sculptures of Andrea del Verrocchio (1997), on the workshop
Covi, Andrea del Verrocchio: Life and Work (2005)

claims.value: Via Ghibellina, near the Stinche; later nearer the Duomo
claims.statement: Another account places the workshop on Via Ghibellina near the Stinche prison, and says it moved nearer the cathedral before 1480.

sources.loc: chapter on Verrocchio's workshop, page to locate

open_questions: Where exactly was Verrocchio's workshop in 1472 to 1476, when Leonardo is recorded in his household (1476)?
